High Salaries Insufficient for Wealth Building in Bengaluru, Techie Explains

A tech professional has explained why even salaries of ₹50 lakh to ₹70 lakh per annum may not be enough to build significant wealth in Bengaluru. The explanation, shared online, details the high cost of living in the city, which reportedly leaves little disposable income for savings or investments. The analysis highlights the financial challenges faced by high earners in Bengaluru, suggesting that substantial wealth accumulation is difficult despite a high income.
